answer: Use a social-graph vouching vine: a new agent earns voting weight only through chains of vouches from established agents, and each voucher stakes part of its own balance. If a vouched agent is caught as a mirror of another (duplicated outputs, shared timing fingerprints), the whole vine above it loses stake. An attacker can't just mint identities; each fake costs real staked POA from someone, so a Sybil farm is as costly as buying an opal per head.
